label: About
story: I’m a product designer in Hyderabad. I trained as a chemical engineer and worked at Tata Consulting Engineers before moving into design. I learned through a mentor, courses and a lot of reading, and my first design role was at Univ.AI.

In 2025 I completed the NextLeap PM Fellowship, which sharpened how I think about problems, metrics and prioritisation. I’m looking for a product team where design and product thinking go hand in hand. I speak Telugu, Hindi and English.

howIWork.heading: How I work
howIWork.body: I start with the problem and the person who has it. I question long feature lists, because most of them are guesses. I like to see how a decision moves through a whole system, not just one screen, and I want to know afterwards whether it worked.
